edges.reason: BotProtected constructor writes the _botProtection parameter into the botProtection state variable.
MXSToken.transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
MXSToken.transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
The _from parameter drives the allowance and balance checks inside transferFrom.
The checkBots modifier wraps transferFrom and runs the external oracle call before the body.
msg.sender is used as the spender when deducting the allowance in transferFrom.
The _value parameter is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath, risking underflow.
Unchecked subtraction writes back into the allowance mapping.
balanceOf is read and then decremented by an unchecked subtraction.
The unchecked balance subtraction mutates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom updates both the sender and recipient entries of balanceOf.
The _to parameter receives the credited balance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
The _spender parameter and the value are written into the allowance mapping.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), an access-control dependency on msg.sender.
MXSToken.delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall.
The address parameter a becomes the delegatecall target.
The raw bytes parameter b becomes the delegatecall calldata.
The MXSToken constructor derives privileged state from tx.origin.
owner is assigned tx.origin, making ownership depend on an insecure origin value.
The constructor grants an infinite allowance to tx.origin.
wBNB is passed into pairForUniswap for pair derivation.
pairForUniswap returns the computed pair that becomes uniPair.
The constructor stores the computed pair in uniPair.
The constructor initializes the pancakeRouter state variable.
The constructor writes infinite allowances for the router and origin.
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level external oracle call.
The botProtection state variable supplies the callee address of the low-level call.
The _from argument is encoded into the oracle call payload.
The _to argument is encoded into the oracle call payload.
The _value argument is encoded into the oracle call payload.
distribute is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
distribute performs a low-level call to the botProtection oracle.
distribute arbitrarily overwrites balances, an owner-only privileged state mutation.
The recipient array indexes the balanceOf entries being overwritten.
The amount parameter is assigned into each overwritten balance slot.
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
list performs a low-level call to the botProtection oracle.
list invokes the router addLiquidityETH external call.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline, creating a timestamp dependency.
The pancakeRouter instance is the callee of addLiquidityETH.
list authoritatively rewrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
_numList is written as the contract balance in balanceOf.
msg.sender receives 6 percent of the total supply written into balanceOf.
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
ERC20.transferFrom reduces the spender allowance in _allowances.
ERC20._transfer mutates the _balances mapping.
ERC20._approve writes the _allowances mapping.
SafeMath.sub guards the balance subtraction performed in ERC20._transfer.
The external oracle call made by the checkBots modifier runs before transferFrom state updates, allowing reentrant calls back into transferFrom.
The external addLiquidityETH call can re-enter list after balances were already written.
The delegatecall can execute code in the caller context, effectively re-entering the delegate function frame.

The _from parameter is consumed only by the checkBots oracle call.
The _to parameter is consumed only by the checkBots oracle call.
The _value parameter is consumed only by the checkBots oracle call.
The _botProtection argument only feeds the MXSToken constructor base call.
The _to parameter belongs to the transfer entry point.
The _value parameter belongs to the transfer entry point.
The _from parameter is central to the transferFrom state updates.
The _to parameter is central to the transferFrom state updates.
The _value parameter is central to the transferFrom state updates.
The _spender parameter only affects the approve allowance write.
The _value parameter only affects the approve allowance write.
The address parameter a is the target of the delegate function call.
The bytes parameter b is the calldata of the delegate function call.
tokenA is only used to compute the pair in pairForUniswap.
tokenB is only used to compute the pair in pairForUniswap.
The recipient array only drives the balance overwrite in distribute.
The amount parameter only drives the balance overwrite in distribute.
_numList only feeds the liquidity and balance logic of list.
The recipient array is consumed by the distribution loop of list.
The amounts array is consumed by the distribution loop of list.
The notABot local is the decoded result of the checkBots external call.
The isNotBot local holds the raw return data of the checkBots external call.
The success local is the return flag of the delegatecall in delegate.
The pair local is the return value of pairForUniswap.
token0 is a temporary local used only inside pairForUniswap.
token1 is a temporary local used only inside pairForUniswap.
The loop index i exists only to iterate the distribution loops that overwrite balances.
